newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ wholesale trade improves in September qtr - SNZ.
newsitem.headline: NZ wholesale trade improves in September qtr - SNZ.

text.p: Wholesale sales increased by 2.0 percent in the September 1996 quarter when compared with the September 1995 quarter, Statistics New Zealand said on Friday.
Overall, seven of the 13 storetypes surveyed recorded increases when compared with the September 1995 quarter. Total wholesale sales in the quarter were NZ$12.088 billion.
The largest percentage increases in sales between the September 1995 and 1996 quarters at 15.5 percent was for the paper and paper product storetype, SNZ said.
Other large percentage increases were recorded by primary product food up 15.4 percent, building materials and supplies up 11.7 percent, and petroleum and petroleum products up 9.3 percent.
Large decreases over this period were recorded for pharmaceuticals and chemicals, down 12.5 percent, household appliances and furniture down 10.1 percent, and metals down 7.1 percent.

Wholesale stocks were valued at $6.338 billion at September 30, 1996, which was 2.5 percent higher than one year ago. This was the eighth consecutive quarter to record an increase when compared with the same time in the previous year.
